method: Per species. src=post: the published post's tags from search-index.json (doubtful 'X ?' excluded, continents/genus/section tags dropped, ancestors of kept places suppressed) — rebuilt nightly, so new subunit tags reach this feed on the next build. src=powo: genus-geo speciesPlaces, same suppression. Each place contributes its pixel-level Koppen distribution (climate.json koppen), read through the card's variant chain (warm strongholds -> warmMoist/warm, else ff, per-place fallback to all). koppen = nine coarse buckets [code, share, label]; koppenFull = full Koppen-Geiger [code, share], entries >= 0.005. cover/show as genus-climate (floor 0.6). zones not shipped — derivable per place. ⚠ the live species card resolves tags against shapes.json, so HD-only places are outside the card's own envelope; this feed uses the full climate vocabulary on purpose. 1.1.0 (S5): species with a stated altitude band (elevation-bands.json, ECOLOGY convention 'altitude: N-M m') also carry elev=[lo,hi], elevBasis, and the clip: koppenElev/koppenElevFull, tnElev/txElev (coldest-month median night, hottest-month median day over the in-band slabs of the taxon's own places, climate.json 1.12.0 elev). A single stated altitude widens one 250 m slab each way; ranges get a half-slab buffer; under 3 in-band pixels the clip is withheld with elevNote rather than guessed.
